combo_label: At the Supermarket × 1980s Pop Culture × The Great Fire of London

entries.clue: Furry cave-dwelling dancer from a 1983 Jim Henson favourite
Class-cutting charmer whose 1986 day off fooled all of Chicago
The City's council house, whose stone shell stood when all within was gone
Minneapolis megastar who heard doves cry in 1984
The City's great market street, its goldsmiths' shops all consumed
Administrative division of the City, each with its own watch and beadle
Choose Life duo who took jitterbugging pop to the top of the 1984 charts
Trader who bones, trims and slices the meat behind a glass front
District on the far bank, saved when flames met a gap in the bridge's houses
Angry crowd that set upon Frenchmen and Dutchmen blamed for starting the blaze
Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
Soft flat plastic wallet of wet cat food, torn open at a little notch
Crumpled film left in your pocket after the chocolate bar is gone
